DelegationMandate.description:
Formal DelegationMandate M2 schema (version 1.0.0): the declarative
authorization contract for delegated side effects. A mandate is granted
by a principal to an executor within an episode, anchored to a role
context (role_assignment + responsibility at pinned versions), scoped by
an exact capability list (no wildcards), bounded by autonomy/risk matrix
(A0-A3 / R0-R3), budget, disclosure policy, and validity window.
The 16-cell autonomy/risk matrix is evaluated against the request risk at
runtime in OMO mandate admission; approval_mode may only tighten a cell's
bar (never loosen it). M2 declares the enums and local invariants below;
cell-level equality is a runtime decision, not an M2 rule. Lifecycle
is a strict active → revoked state machine: a mandate can only be revoked
(never re-activated, never mutated in place — revocation produces a new
mandate_version with status=revoked and a fresh trace_id). active means
the mandate is eligible for admission, not that its side effects are
automatically allowed to execute.

M2BaseSchema.description:
M2 schema 抽象基类 - 所有 m2/*.yaml 文件的元模式。

每个 m2 schema 文件必须满足 4 字段公共契约:
  1. m2_type: schema 唯一类型 ID (PascalCase)
  2. version: semver (1.0.0 起)
  3. created: ISO-8601 timestamp
  4. <SchemaName>: 顶层 dict (含 m3_parent / description / stateMachine / requiredProperties / ...)

本 M2BaseSchema 不要求 schema 文件显式声明 m2_parent: M2BaseSchema
(50 schema 隐式继承, 避免历史 schema 改动).

_schema_body.description: 顶层 body 必须有 m3_parent + description 字段 (M3 自反锚定)

relationConstraints.description: 与其他 m2 schema 的关系约束 (can_be_source_of / target_of)

M2BaseSchema.title: M2BaseSchema
